mechanism.claim: A high-variation BTC day whose Binance spot share of combined spot and perpetual quote turnover is unusually large reflects cash-sponsored price discovery rather than derivatives-only leverage. If spot and perpetual completed-day returns agree, their common direction should relay for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed prior-day Binance spot and perpetual returns
mechanism.why_distinct: SLVCR used hourly spot-versus-perpetual return magnitude under joint BVOL/DVOL expansion; DCVPR used Upbit/Binance participation rotation and FX; HVPASR used premium-index total variation. HVSPSR uses a full-day Binance cash share of quote turnover, no venue-return leadership, no implied-volatility feed, no FX, and no premium-index field.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed perpetual realized variation must rank at least 0.65 causally
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily cash-participation-conditioned 00:05 UTC clock is absent from Gross9

features.spot: 1,440 exact bars_binance_spot BTCUSDT 1m rows with finite positive OHLC and nonnegative quote_asset_volume
features.perpetual: 1,440 exact bars_binance BTCUSDT 1m rows with finite positive coherent OHLC and nonnegative quote_asset_volume
features.returns: log(last close/first open) independently by venue; both strict nonzero and same sign
features.spot_participation_share: sum spot quote_asset_volume / sum(spot plus perpetual quote_asset_volume); denominator strict positive
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared perpetual 1m log(close/open)) over all 1,440 bars; strict positive
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 270 earlier source-valid days, minimum 180; current excluded
features.eligibility: spot-participation rank>=0.75 and perpetual realized-variation rank>=0.65
features.availability: D 00:00 UTC after both source paths complete

clock.decision: exact D 00:00 UTC after prior UTC day completes
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT perpetual D 00:05 UTC open
clock.reservation: fixed daily opportunities are nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol_rv20: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economic stages pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no day, source, rank, agreement, side, hold, timing, subset, threshold, or control repair.
